title: Mia and Leo
text:
Mia has a new doll. The doll has long brown hair. Mia plays with her doll every day. She takes the doll to the park.

Leo has a red car. He likes to race his car on the floor. His sister has a ball. They play games together after dinner.

questions.text: What color is the doll's hair?
What does Leo like to do with his car?
Mia probably loves her doll. How do you know?
options: She plays with it every day

questions.text: Leo and his sister play together after dinner. What can we guess about them?

vocabulary.definition: a toy that looks like a small person
to run or move fast against someone else
a girl or woman who has the same parents as you
the main meal of the evening

paragraph_translations: Mia tiene una muñeca nueva. La muñeca tiene el pelo largo y castaño. Mia juega con su muñeca todos los días. Lleva la muñeca al parque.
Leo tiene un coche rojo. Le gusta hacer carreras con su coche en el suelo. Su hermana tiene una pelota. Juegan juntos después de la cena.
